# apple_app (Data Source)

Looks up an app record by its App Store Connect ID or bundle identifier. Apps cannot be created through the App Store Connect API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bundle_id` (String) Bundle identifier of the app, e.g. `com.example.app`. Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID (Apple ID) of the app. Set this or `bundle_id`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the app.
- `primary_locale` (String) Primary locale of the app, e.g. `en-US`.
- `sku` (String) SKU of the app.
